verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ بِلْدَدُ ٱلشُّوحِيُّ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.web: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י וַיֹאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «إِلَى مَتَى تَقُولُ هَذَا، وَتَكُونُ أَقْوَالُ فِيكَ رِيحًا شَدِيدَةً؟
verses.kjv: How long wilt thou speak these [things]? and [how long shall] the words of thy mouth [be like] a strong wind?
verses.web: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
verses.he: עַד־אָ֥ן תְּמַלֶּל־אֵ֑לֶּה וְר֥וּחַ כַּ֝בִּיר אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: هَلِ ٱللهُ يُعَوِّجُ ٱلْقَضَاءَ، أَوِ ٱلْقَدِيرُ يَعْكِسُ ٱلْحَقَّ؟
verses.kjv: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.web: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
verses.he: הַ֭אֵל יְעַוֵּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְאִם־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יְעַוֵּֽת־צֶֽדֶק׃

verses.ar: إِذْ أَخْطَأَ إِلَيْهِ بَنُوكَ، دَفَعَهُمْ إِلَى يَدِ مَعْصِيَتِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
verses.web: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
verses.he: אִם־בָּנֶ֥יךָ חָֽטְאוּ־לֹ֑ו וַֽ֝יְשַׁלְּחֵ֗ם בְּיַד־פִּשְׁעָֽם׃

verses.ar: فَإِنْ بَكَّرْتَ أَنْتَ إِلَى ٱللهِ وَتَضَرَّعْتَ إِلَى ٱلْقَدِيرِ،
verses.kjv: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.web: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
verses.he: אִם־אַ֭תָּה תְּשַׁחֵ֣ר אֶל־אֵ֑ל וְאֶל־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י תִּתְחַנָּֽן׃

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتَ أَنْتَ زَكِيًّا مُسْتَقِيمًا، فَإِنَّهُ ٱلْآنَ يَتَنَبَّهُ لَكَ وَيُسْلِمُ مَسْكَنَ بِرِّكَ.
verses.kjv: If thou [wert] pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.web: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
verses.he: אִם־זַ֥ךְ וְיָשָׁ֗ר אָ֥תָּה כִּי־עַ֭תָּה יָעִ֣יר עָלֶ֑יךָ וְ֝שִׁלַּ֗ם נְוַ֣ת צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: وَإِنْ تَكُنْ أُولَاكَ صَغِيرَةً فَآخِرَتُكَ تَكْثُرُ جِدًّا.
verses.kjv: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
verses.web: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
verses.he: וְהָיָ֣ה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ֣ מִצְעָ֑ר וְ֝אַחֲרִיתְךָ֗ יִשְׂגֶּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

verses.ar: «اِسْأَلِ ٱلْقُرُونَ ٱلْأُولَى وَتَأَكَّدْ مَبَاحِثَ آبَائِهِمْ،
verses.kjv: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
verses.web: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
verses.he: כִּֽי־שְׁאַל־נָ֭א לְדֹ֣ר רִישֹׁ֑ון וְ֝כֹונֵ֗ן לְחֵ֣קֶר אֲבֹותָֽם׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّنَا نَحْنُ مِنْ أَمْسٍ وَلَا نَعْلَمُ، لِأَنَّ أَيَّامَنَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ظِلٌّ.
verses.kjv: (For we [are but of] yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth [are] a shadow:)
verses.web: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
verses.he: כִּֽי־תְמֹ֣ול אֲ֭נַחְנוּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע כִּ֤י צֵ֖ל יָמֵ֣ינוּ עֲלֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: فَهَلَّا يُعْلِمُونَكَ؟ يَقُولُونَ لَكَ، وَمِنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ يُخْرِجُونَ أَقْوَالًا قَائِلِينَ:
verses.kjv: Shall not they teach thee, [and] tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.web: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.he: הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם יֹ֭ורוּךָ יֹ֣אמְרוּ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝מִלִּבָּ֗ם יֹוצִ֥אוּ מִלִּֽים׃

verses.ar: هَلْ يَنْمِي ٱلْبَرْدِيُّ فِي غَيْرِ ٱلْغَمَقَةِ، أَوْ تَنْبُتُ ٱلْحَلْفَاءُ بِلَا مَاءٍ؟
verses.kjv: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
verses.web: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
verses.he: הֲיִֽגְאֶה־גֹּ֭מֶא בְּלֹ֣א בִצָּ֑ה יִשְׂגֶּה־אָ֥חוּ בְלִי־מָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: وَهُوَ بَعْدُ فِي نَضَارَتِهِ لَمْ يُقْطَعْ، يَيْبَسُ قَبْلَ كُلِّ ٱلْعُشْبِ.
verses.kjv: Whilst it [is] yet in his greenness, [and] not cut down, it withereth before any [other] herb.
verses.web: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
verses.he: עֹדֶ֣נּוּ בְ֭אִבֹּו לֹ֣א יִקָּטֵ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָל־חָצִ֣יר יִיבָֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: هَكَذَا سُبُلُ كُلِّ ٱلنَّاسِينَ ٱللهَ، وَرَجَاءُ ٱلْفَاجِرِ يَخِيبُ،
verses.kjv: So [are] the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:
verses.web: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
verses.he: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחֹות כָּל־שֹׁ֣כְחֵי אֵ֑ל וְתִקְוַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף תֹּאבֵֽד׃

verses.ar: فَيَنْقَطِعُ ٱعْتِمَادُهُ، وَمُتَّكَلُهُ بَيْتُ ٱلْعَنْكَبُوتِ!
verses.kjv: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust [shall be] a spider’s web.
verses.web: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.
verses.he: אֲשֶׁר־יָקֹ֥וט כִּסְלֹ֑ו וּבֵ֥ית עַ֝כָּבִ֗ישׁ מִבְטַחֹֽו׃

verses.ar: يَسْتَنِدُ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ فَلَا يَثْبُتُ. يَتَمَسَّكُ بِهِ فَلَا يَقُومُ.
verses.kjv: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.web: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
verses.he: יִשָּׁעֵ֣ן עַל־בֵּ֭יתֹו וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֑ד יַחֲזִ֥יק בֹּ֝֗ו וְלֹ֣א יָקֽוּם׃

verses.ar: هُوَ رَطْبٌ تُجَاهَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَعَلَى جَنَّتِهِ تَنْبُتُ خَرَاعِيبُهُ.
verses.kjv: He [is] green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
verses.web: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
verses.he: רָטֹ֣ב ה֖וּא לִפְנֵי־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְעַ֥ל גַּ֝נָּתֹ֗ו יֹֽנַקְתֹּ֥ו תֵצֵֽא׃

verses.ar: وَأُصُولُهُ مُشْتَبِكَةٌ فِي ٱلرُّجْمَةِ، فَتَرَى مَحَلَّ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ.
verses.kjv: His roots are wrapped about the heap, [and] seeth the place of stones.
verses.web: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
verses.he: עַל־גַּ֭ל שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ בֵּ֖ית אֲבָנִ֣ים יֶחֱזֶֽה׃

verses.ar: إِنِ ٱقْتَلَعَهُ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ، يَجْحَدُهُ قَائِلًا: مَا رَأَيْتُكَ!
verses.kjv: If he destroy him from his place, then [it] shall deny him, [saying], I have not seen thee.
verses.web: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
verses.he: אִם־יְבַלְּעֶ֥נּוּ מִמְּקֹומֹ֑ו וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בֹּ֝֗ו לֹ֣א רְאִיתִֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: هَذَا هُوَ فَرَحُ طَرِيقِهِ، وَمِنَ ٱلتُّرَابِ يَنْبُتُ آخَرُ.
verses.kjv: Behold, this [is] the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
verses.web: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.
verses.he: הֶן־ה֭וּא מְשֹׂ֣ושׂ דַּרְכֹּ֑ו וּ֝מֵעָפָ֗ר אַחֵ֥ר יִצְמָֽחוּ׃

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا ٱللهُ لَا يَرْفُضُ ٱلْكَامِلَ، وَلَا يَأْخُذُ بِيَدِ فَاعِلِي ٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect [man], neither will he help the evil doers:
verses.web: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
verses.he: הֶן־אֵ֭ל לֹ֣א יִמְאַס־תָּ֑ם וְלֹֽא־יַ֝חֲזִ֗יק בְּיַד־מְרֵעִֽים׃

verses.ar: عِنْدَمَا يَمْلَأُ فَاكَ ضَحِكًا، وَشَفَتَيْكَ هُتَافًا،
verses.kjv: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verses.web: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
verses.he: עַד־יְמַלֵּ֣ה שְׂחֹ֣וק פִּ֑יךָ וּשְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ תְרוּעָֽה׃

verses.ar: يَلْبَسُ مُبْغِضُوكَ خِزْيًا، أَمَّا خَيْمَةُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَلَا تَكُونُ».
verses.kjv: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.web: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
verses.he: שֹׂנְאֶ֥יךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹ֑שֶׁת וְאֹ֖הֶל רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃ פ
